title: Private Search Engines Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Level
metaDescription: Calculate your search privacy risk level. Assess tracking exposure from Google, Bing vs private alternatives like DuckDuckGo and Startpage.
description: Evaluate your current search engine privacy risks and discover how switching to private alternatives like DuckDuckGo or Startpage can protect your data from tracking and profiling.

inputs.label: Current Primary Search Engine
inputs.helpText: Which search engine do you use most often?

inputs.label: Daily Search Queries
inputs.helpText: Approximate number of searches you perform per day

inputs.label: Signed into Search Account
inputs.helpText: How often are you logged into your Google/Microsoft account while searching?

inputs.label: Sensitive Search Frequency
inputs.helpText: How often do you search for personal, health, financial, or sensitive topics?

inputs.label: Ad Personalization Settings
inputs.helpText: Have you disabled ad personalization in your search engine settings?

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall privacy risk from your current search habits (0-100 scale)

outputFields.label: Est. Monthly Data Points
outputFields.description: Approximate data points collected about you per month

outputFields.label: Recommended Action
outputFields.description: Primary recommendation to improve your search privacy

formula: const engineRisk = { google: 85, bing: 80, yahoo: 75, duckduckgo: 10, startpage: 15, searx: 5, brave: 20 }; const baseRisk = engineRisk[currentSearchEngine] || 50; const loginMultiplier = { always: 1.3, sometimes: 1.1, never: 0.8 }; const sensitiveMultiplier = { high: 1.4, moderate: 1.1, low: 0.9 }; const adMultiplier = { enabled: 1.2, partial: 1.0, disabled: 0.8 }; const volumeMultiplier = Math.min(1 + (dailySearches - 10) * 0.01, 1.5); const riskScore = Math.min(Math.round(baseRisk * loginMultiplier[loggedInStatus] * sensitiveMultiplier[sensitiveSearches] * adMultiplier[adPersonalization] * volumeMultiplier), 100); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 80 ? 'High Risk' : riskScore >= 60 ? 'Moderate Risk' : riskScore >= 40 ? 'Low-Moderate Risk' : riskScore >= 20 ? 'Low Risk' : 'Minimal Risk'; const dataPointsCollected = Math.round(dailySearches * 30 * (riskScore / 100) * 2.5); const recommendation = currentSearchEngine === 'google' || currentSearchEngine === 'bing' ? 'Switch to DuckDuckGo or Startpage for better privacy' : currentSearchEngine === 'duckduckgo' || currentSearchEngine === 'startpage' ? 'Consider using Incognito Browser for additional protection' : 'Your search engine choice is privacy-focused - well done!'; return { riskScore, riskLevel, dataPointsCollected, recommendation };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your search privacy risk based on your search engine choice, usage patterns, account status, and privacy settings. Traditional search engines like Google and Bing collect extensive data for advertising, while private alternatives like DuckDuckGo don't track users.
tips: Switch to DuckDuckGo or Startpage for private searching without tracking
Use Incognito Browser to prevent local storage of search history
Avoid staying logged into Google/Microsoft accounts while searching
Disable ad personalization in your current search engine settings
Use different search engines for sensitive vs. general queries
Clear search history regularly from your browser and accounts
Consider using a VPN for additional anonymity while searching

interpretation.label: Minimal Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy practices. You're using private search engines effectively.

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy protection. Minor improvements could enhance your privacy further.

interpretation.label: Low-Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy concerns. Consider switching to a private search engine.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Significant tracking exposure. Switch to DuckDuckGo or Startpage immediately.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Maximum tracking exposure. Your searches are heavily monitored and profiled.
